folds: Five StratifiedGroupKFold groups, seed 4262, strata label + 2 * source. A gene has the same fold across both samples.

logistic.features: Across-read means of the nine raw signal channels.
logistic.preprocessing: Standardization fitted on each training fold.

m6anet_released.inference: exact expectation of native sampling: 20 draws with replacement

m6anet_retrained.normalization: Raw units, read-weighted physical 5-mer mean/SD, training genes only
m6anet_retrained.training: Balanced site oversampling; 20 reads without replacement; noisy-OR BCE
m6anet_retrained.selection: Inner gene PR-AUC on exact expectation of deployed 20-read sampling with replacement
m6anet_retrained.refit: Fresh random initialization and scaling on all outer training genes, for the selected epoch count
